title: New Releases: KR Sewer Central Tileset , Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th - Little Monsters and Robots 1

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
New Sewer Tiles, New Enemies to fight. Two new packs for RPG Maker, now live!
​
Make sure you’re wearing some heavy duty boots before climbing down into trash-filled tunnels made with the KR Sewer Central Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another detailed tileset size for MV and MZ, focusing on the damp, grimey, floors and walls you’d expect if you dropped down a manhole and started exploring a sewer tunnel. A1, A2, and A4 tiles are ready to help you build concrete and brick tunnels deep underground, and B sheets offer up a variety of pipes, wall decorations, and trash to help make each path feel unique.
Send your heroes down a staircase to wander next to noxious green or brown water in the hopes of finding a bandit’s hideout filled with barrels and chests. Or let them follow metal pipes along the tunnels to locate where a slime is clogging the pipes so that the townsfolk can safely use their sinks again. Have your heroes follow bright graffiti between piles of trash to confront a young troublemaker who could join the party, and enter the sewer under a castle to gain access to a small jail that’s been forgotten by most of the people living above the ground.
This pack also includes 8 character sprites to add doors and more to your maps. Keep your heroes out of certain areas with metal gates, at least until they pull a lever tucked away on a nearby wall. Light the tunnels with dancing flames and mark a special room with tall wooden doors that open up to reveal a side room where red treasure chests wait to be opened. So if your modern game needs a sewer level or you want to offer a smelly way to sneak into a castle’s jail, check out the KR Sewer Central Tileset!

​
Add some quirky lil’ creatures to your battles with Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th - Little Monsters and Robots 1! Tyler Warren is back with his unique colored pencil art style to deliver 40 new battlers for your heroes to challenge. Get ready to battle armored sea creatures, well-dressed cyclops, angry robots, and more! Have your heroes battle against waves of red-cloaked cultists who can summon living tree stumps to ride and bright mushrooms that can release poisonous clouds of spores, or sneak past them by going underground where green-plated insects live in peace with little yellow cyclops and clouds of living smoke. Let your players explore modern city streets and sci-fi warehouses where robots designed for drilling, floating, grabbing, and fighting roam looking for trespassers, and face off against the enhanced Cyclops Siblings after your heroes beat up a baby sea turtle in the hopes of gaining a special shield!
Each enemy comes in multiple sizes so you can simply pick one that fits your game’s screen size without any resizing on your part, as well as pixel art versions with 9 different color versions inspired by the palettes of the GameBoy, NES, TimeFantasy, and more! Have your enemies match the palette of the rest of your retro pixel art game, or use them to show when your heroes are playing a combat-heavy minigame. Pick up Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th - Little Monsters and Robots 1 and add a bunch of new monsters for your heroes to defeat to your games!

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
I like KR tiles, and when I saw that it was a sewer set, I thought I might get them.  But no.  What I find unhelpful about these sewer tiles is that the floors are spotlessly clean.  All pipework is gleaming, with not a grain of rust (or anything else!).  No marks on the walls, no sign that a pipe joint has ever leaked, nothing in fact that would lend some atmosphere.  All that would have to be edited in, in which case I might as well stick with what I've got.
Does anyone from KR read these comments?  It's unlikely, but just in case: please mess the tiles up!
